routes.name: Narrow Orbit
routes.premise: One tiny rainy-evening room; a shared extension cord moves from slack to taut to jointly repaired while body distance and practical light carry the emotional arc.

routes.name: Duvet Tension
routes.premise: A shared duvet becomes tug-of-war, dropped boundary and eventual coordinated bed-making.

routes.name: Unflattering Reflections
routes.premise: Mirrors, glass and dark screens make distorted faces literal before direct eye contact returns.

routes.name: Acoustic Choreography
routes.premise: Keys, chair and drawer noises become louder as the room compresses, then stop in one shared silence.

routes.name: Bare Blocking
routes.premise: No central object; only eye-lines, squeezed crossings and changing room geometry show the conflict and repair.
